review:
Voodoo People is a Halloween-style 25-line slot set in a mystical shop, where the shopkeeper appears as a wild that can land in several places at once. Its main bonus is a Mega Jackpot Hold & Win game with sticky Voodoo symbols.

The more Voodoos you collect, the bigger the win, and at the end of the round, lines filled with Voodoos gain multipliers. The other bonus offers eight free spins with only high-paying symbols. You can light enchanted candles for 2.5 times the bonus chance, or buy a bonus where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 7,500x maximum and a 96.88% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 228 spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
